_comment: Built-in debug adapters (DAP). An adapter only starts when its command is found (same search path as language servers). transport: 'stdio' = the adapter speaks DAP on stdin/stdout; 'tcp-listen' = the adapter prints 'listening at: host:port' and the editor connects. In 'launch' and 'prelaunch', ${file}, ${dir} (the file's directory, launch only) and ${root} (the project root) and ${debug_bin} (the ghp debug binary: .lumen/ghp-debug/app, app.exe on Windows) are replaced. 'prelaunch' is a build step that must succeed before the adapter starts. 'normalize_paths' maps the source paths the adapter reports (and the editor sends) back to the project. 'experimental' adapters are listed but never chosen automatically.
